mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope WHERE organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.retention_policy (retention_policy_id, policy_code, policy_name, owner_organization_unit_id, policy_status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{retentionPolicyId}, #{policyCode}, #{policyName}, #{ownerOrganizationUnitId}, 'ACTIVE', #{actorId}, #{actorId})

INSERT INTO seal.retention_policy_version (retention_policy_version_id, retention_policy_id, version_number, workflow_status, start_event, period_value, period_unit, grace_period_days, destruction_method, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{retentionPolicyVersionId}, #{retentionPolicyId}, #{versionNumber}, 'DRAFT', #{startEvent}, #{periodValue}, #{periodUnit}, #{gracePeriodDays}, #{destructionMethod}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE ) SELECT version.retention_policy_version_id, version.retention_policy_id, version.version_number, version.workflow_status, version.start_event, version.period_value, version.period_unit, version.grace_period_days, version.destruction_method, version.created_by, version.review_requested_by, version.approved_by, version.rejection_comment, version.version_no FROM seal.retention_policy_version version JOIN seal.retention_policy policy ON policy.retention_policy_id = version.retention_policy_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE version.retention_policy_id = #{retentionPolicyId} AND version.retention_policy_version_id = #{retentionPolicyVersionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.retention_policy_version SET workflow_status = #{version.workflowStatus}, review_requested_by = #{version.reviewRequestedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, review_requested_at = CASE WHEN #{version.workflowStatus} = 'REVIEW_REQUESTED' THEN #{occurredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} WHEN #{version.workflowStatus} = 'DRAFT' THEN NULL ELSE review_requested_at END, approved_by = #{version.approvedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{version.workflowStatus} = 'APPROVED' THEN CAST(#{occurredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ELSE NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ END, rejection_comment = #{version.rejectionComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{occurredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE retention_policy_version_id = #{version.retentionPolicyVersionId} AND version_no = #{version.versionNo}
